integrity: The proof is self-contained; finite exact computations independently corroborate the displayed formulas but do not replace an all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only normalized relative ideals of the explicitly defined two-parameter depth-two semigroups; earlier non-divisorial-ideal material was partly inaccessible, so historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Run-length rigidity and genus-refined census of reflexive ideals in depth-two numerical semigroups
